title: From Cycle Space to Cycle Manifold: Limits and Achievability of Blind False Data Injection Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2609.10631v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A false data injection attack (FDIA) can change the estimated grid state while evading a residual-based bad data detector (BDD). Existing blind attacks learn a low-rank measurement subspace, but this algebraic view does not state the physical grid constraints that make an attack stealthy or the minimum information needed to recover the complete attack space. Under the connected direct-current (DC) branch-flow model, we show that the residual-sensitive subspace of the noiseless orthogonal test is exactly the weighted cycle space. Its orthogonal complement is therefore the complete stealthy attack space, making weighted cycle-space knowledge both necessary and sufficient for complete blind FDIA. This space identifies the topology only up to 2-isomorphism and the relative cycle-edge parameters only up to one scale per biconnected component; bridge parameters are neither identified nor required. translated_title: 从循环空间到循环流形：盲假数据注入攻击的极限与可达成性
translated_abstract: 假数据注入攻击（FDIA）能够在规避基于残差的坏数据检测器（BDD）的同时改变电网的估计状态。现有的盲攻击方法学习低秩测量子空间，但这种代数视角既未阐明使攻击隐蔽的物理电网约束，也未说明恢复完整攻击空间所需的最小信息量。在连通的直流（DC）支路潮流模型下，我们证明无噪声正交测试的残差敏感子空间恰好就是加权循环空间。因此，其正交补空间构成了完整的隐蔽攻击空间，这使得加权循环空间知识对于实现完整的盲FDIA既是必要的又是充分的。该空间识别拓扑仅能精确到2-同构，识别相对循环边参数仅能精确到每个双连通分量一个尺度；桥接参数既无法被识别也无需被识别。随后我们构建了一个计算上无约束的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了盲假数据注入攻击的完整隐蔽攻击空间恰好等于加权循环空间的正交补，从而确立加权循环空间知识对实现完整盲FDIA的充要性，并刻画了拓扑与循环参数可辨识性的理论极限。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the complete stealthy attack space of blind false data injection attacks is exactly the orthogonal complement of the weighted cycle space, establishing that weighted cycle-space knowledge is both necessary and sufficient for complete blind FDIA, and characterizing the fundamental identifiability limits of topology and cycle parameters.
